high_level_description: stc brand style, a modern architectural photograph of a beige pavilion with a water feature.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Landscaped grounds with artificial rocks, green vegetation, a modern institutional building with a grid-like facade in the background, and tree branches framing the top left corner, lit by soft early morning or late afternoon light.

elements.desc: A beige-colored pavilion with a tall central spire and a colonnade of arched columns supporting a flat roof.
A geometric rectangular water feature in the foreground, reflecting the pavilion and surrounding structures, connected by a curved concrete pathway.
